propositions: tests/unit/test_build_provenance.py rebuilds identical clean-source wheel and sdist artifacts three times across four tests, causing 35.93s module duration when the unchanged build takes 4–8s per invocation

session-scoped per-worker fixture should build wheel and sdist once under REBAR_BUILD_COMMIT=abc1234 and expose only immutable artifact paths to consumers, eliminating duplicate prerequisite builds while preserving distinct env-unset rebuild and empty-env failure executions
shared wheel and sdist consumers must receive read-only paths; function-scoped extraction and rebuild work must use local copies to prevent mutation of shared state
defect-seeded duplicate prerequisite build and missing COMMIT in shared artifact must fail deterministic call-count and provenance oracles respectively
